provenance.citation: Solin, Kok, Wahlstrom, Schon, and Sarkka (2018), Modeling and interpolation of the ambient magnetic field by Gaussian processes.
provenance.licence_note: No explicit licence file was present in the pinned upstream tree. Upstream requests attribution; do not infer additional redistribution permissions.

protocol.selection: Minimum measured source-validation vector RMSE; all choices frozen before test labels.
protocol.targets: Kernel predictions at actual training positions; no synthetic observations.
protocol.assumptions: Flat observation plane z=0; equivalent dipoles at assumed z=-depth; static source-free air above sheet.

original_protocol.units: reference Invensense numerical recording units; not independently calibrated SI

protocol.limitations: Previously examined tests: exploratory reuse. Equivalent sources are nonunique, not identified room objects. Reference units, not SI moments.
